description: Bumps the task-blueprint capability to declare whether a task needs manual or visual verification, alongside the existing Review field. This lets the implementer check evidence availability before writing any code (see migration 017's manual-verification-precondition capability), instead of discovering the gap only after finishing an implementation that automated checks already passed.
delta: Add a `Manual verification: [none / required]` field immediately after `Review` in the task blueprint's field block. No other field changes.
verification: tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md's MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=task-blueprint v2 marker declares `Manual verification: [none / required]` immediately after `Review: REQUIRED`
No other field in the blueprint's field block changed
